title: Bous Stephanoumenos
html_source: (Greek) Garlanded Bull.[3] In A Portrait of the Artist as a Young man Stephen’s school-mates call to him: Bous Stephanoumenos! Bous Stephaneforos! (Crowned Bull! Garland-bearing Bull!). Stephen’s name is derived from the Greek stephanos (στέφανος), which means crown, garland, wreath, crown of victory, prize. It has been suggested that Stephen sees himself as the sacrificial beast, garlanded in preparation for the sacrificial rites
